Swalwell resigned from Congress in April after facing allegations of sexual assault and other misconduct from several women. He has acknowledged making “mistakes in judgment,” but has denied an assault allegation. He has not been charged. | CBS News

item.title: Germany blames Russia for airport drone incident, hits back with sanctions
item.description: Germany on Tuesday blamed Russia for an attempted "hybrid attack" involving an explosive-laden drone at a strategic airport last month and announced diplomatic counter-measures. The European Union expressed "full solidarity" with Germany, NATO assured that it would defend its members and countries including Britain, Estonia and Poland offered strong backing. Germany will close Russia's consulate in the former capital Bonn later this month, and cancel the contract for the Russian House, a cultural centre in Berlin, said Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul. FRANCE 24's Carys Garland reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: WWII-era plane packed into boxes in 1953 moved with its owner for 50 years before restoration
item.description: The WACO UPF-7 was used as a primary trainer from 1941, helping prepare pilots through the US government-backed Civilian Pilot Training Program during the World War II era. Retired in 1953, the aircraft was bought by a Florida owner who dismantled and packed it into boxes, carrying the parts through three moves over 50 years. Rediscovered in 2002, it was later restored by RARE Aircraft and returned to airworthy condition before being displayed at the Historic Flight Foundation. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
